svg.title: A read-after-write consistency violation
svg.desc: Time runs downward along the client and replica A and B timelines. Initially x has value v0 at timestamp t0. The client writes x = v1 at a later timestamp t1. The write to A is lost, but B stores it. The client then reads x. The request to B is lost, and A responds with the older pair (t0, v0). The client reads an older value than its own write, violating read-your-writes consistency.
